rows.label: tlk46320171_04_msg0002
rows.name:
Word is that a massive fish has been
spotted off Baldotas Island in the
Liberalitas Archipelago.

rows.label: tlk46320171_04_msg0003
rows.name:
I've heard its flesh tastes like
nothing else in this world.

rows.label: tlk46320171_04_msg0004
rows.name:
When you hear something like that,
it only makes you more curious,
doesn't it?

rows.label: tlk46320171_04_msg0005
rows.name: At least, that's how I feel!

rows.label: tlk46320171_04_msg0006
rows.name: What I'd give for a taste...

rows.label: tlk46320171_04_msg0007
rows.name:
But there's no way I could fish
that beast out by myself.

rows.label: tlk46320171_04_msg0008
rows.name:
So, I'm on the lookout for
someone to lend a hand, but
no one seems to be up for it.

rows.label: tlk46320171_04_msg0009
rows.name:
If I give up now, who knows when
I'll get another chance...

rows.label: tlk46320171_04_msg0010
rows.name:
Oh! You'll help me?
That's very reassuring!

rows.label: tlk46320171_04_msg0011
rows.name:
Once we land that giant fish,
let's enjoy the taste together!
